items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: My father was a music teacher. Yes, we knew. His name was James. James Humphrey.

ctx.x: I'll drive some now. Here's 72 and Mr. Humphrey's 79. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I'm not smoking. You never even bottle too much. You never do smoke. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. My father was a music teacher. Yes, we knew. His name was James. James Humphrey. Yeah, I was looking at his picture. That's why I was on. He taught. He taught. My brother was playing there when he was about five years. And then he taught him to follow my brother's children.
And James, if he wants to ask some questions, then he can get him on tape.
